items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: A3 acceptance: global screens + per-split fallback via freeze_splits authority, non-UI/skipped-task passes, plan uses task split, both skip keys, canon ImportError and run id surfaced; phase_validators.py shrank 228->165.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Config reads tolerate absent/corrupt/non-object JSON; split resolver now guards non-dict configs; canon import failures classified, never swallowed.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Design skip is read only from orchestrator-owned run_config, never a file the gated phase writes (review finding fixed).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 30 new tests in the run plugin root incl. consumer path via run_phase_gate; 630 run-plugin tests green; changed modules at 100% line coverage.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Only a few small file reads and one directory glob per validation.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Split-aware validators in their own sibling module; all files under 300 lines; kind=canon_degraded as a machine-readable marker.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: validate_phase gains defaulted keywords only; existing callers (run_phase_gate, tests) unchanged and round-trip-tested through run_phase_gate.
